# AVANTRA 2026

> AVANTRA is a two-day, multiverse-themed science fair and exhibition for school students, starting 19 December 2026 at SSRVM IEMS (Ispat English Medium School), Sector 20, Rourkela, Odisha. SSRVM IEMS hosts it, ARITHI is the event partner, and student clubs from NIT Rourkela show projects and run sessions.

- Day 1: opening, the inaugural session and the science exhibition (school students and NIT Rourkela clubs).
- Day 2: competitive events and challenges, more exhibition, then results and the closing ceremony.
- Science Exhibition: enter alone or in a team of up to 3. Juniors are classes 6–8, seniors classes 9–12.
- Fee: ₹299 per student, paid by UPI to the school and checked by the organisers.
- Registration: through the website. It opens soon; follow Instagram or WhatsApp for the date.

## Pages

- [Home](https://avantra.arithi.in/): overview and countdown
- [Events](https://avantra.arithi.in/events): exhibition, judging criteria, prizes, drone, RC plane, satellite and rocket, and robotics events
- [About](https://avantra.arithi.in/about): what AVANTRA is and who runs it
- [Venue](https://avantra.arithi.in/venue): address and directions
- [Organizers](https://avantra.arithi.in/organizers): the committee
- [Ambassadors](https://avantra.arithi.in/ambassador): apply to be a school ambassador
- [Contact](https://avantra.arithi.in/contact): send the organisers a message
